items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...with Louis on the cornet. [INTERVIEWEE]: Dave Payton, you heard Dave Payton.

ctx.x: What about Big Al Louis Robertson, the piano player, not Big Al Louis the clarinet player? Do you know him? Sir Robertson, no, I don't know. What about Cato? Do you know him? Yeah, I know Cato. He's uptown there. Which one? Cato. Cato. Big Cato or Little Cato? Big Cato. He's still living. It's still uptown there,

towards the Irish Channel. I'll try to locate him for you if you want. They'll try to locate him for you. Yeah, if you want to cross him. Yeah. You know? Cato and then there. Old timers, old timers. They were very popular in that day. Very popular. Oh, they were very popular in that day. Oh, they played with jazz in that day like that.
